lines.en: label day63:
scene daysixthree1

You know, back when I woke up here for the first time and realized that I was going to be spending every day surrounded by teenagers...I don't think I understood exactly how loud that was going to be.
lines.zh: 要知道，当初我第一次在这里醒来，意识到自己每天都要被一群青少年包围着的时候……我觉得我并没有真正理解那会有多吵。

lines.en: I also don't think I understood exactly how long school days carry on for either. Because even though we're only one hour into this one, I am already clocked out for the day.
lines.zh: 我也没有真正理解学校的一天到底能有多漫长。因为尽管现在才过去一个小时，我已经打卡下班了。

lines.en: Granted, I double-punch my metaphorical time card every time I show up to school, so I guess you can say that I've been clocked out since I got here.
lines.zh: 诚然，我每次一到学校，就相当于把那张隐喻的考勤卡打了两次卡，所以你也可以说，我从到这儿起就已经下班了。

lines.en: Either way, when I first decided to just take on this job instead of going out and finding a new one, I thought it would be kind of fun.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，当初我决定干脆接下这份工作，而不是出去另找一份的时候，我以为会挺有意思的。

lines.en: I thought I’d spend my days flirting with [high_school] girls and manipulating them into eventually performing sex acts with and/or on me.
lines.zh: 我以为我会整天跟[high_school]女生调情，慢慢把她们哄到床上，让她们跟我、或者在我身上做那种事。

lines.en: And while there is absolutely a semblance of truth to that, the overwhelming majority of my time is just...this.
lines.zh: 虽然这话确实有几分真实，但我绝大部分的时间就只是……这样。

lines.en: I can't even make it through a single morning without something exhausting happening.
lines.zh: 我连一个上午都撑不过去，就一定会发生点让人精疲力竭的事。

lines.en: scene daysixthree2
: Sensei! Do you want any pizza?
lines.zh: : 老师！你要吃披萨吗？

lines.en: Do you see what I mean?
lines.zh: 你明白我的意思了吧？

lines.en: : Ayane, it’s 9:00 in the morning.
lines.zh: : Ayane，现在是早上九点。

lines.en: : So?
lines.zh: : 那又怎样？

lines.en: : Where did you even get a pizza that early?
lines.zh: : 你这么早是从哪儿弄来的披萨？

lines.en: : I had Geoffrey make it and drive it over during homeroom. Did you not see the entire convoy of limos outside?
lines.zh: : 我让 Geoffrey 做好，在班会时间开车送过来的。你没看到外面那一整队豪车吗？

lines.en: : Why did you need an entire convoy for one pizza?
lines.zh: : 一个披萨为什么需要一整队车？

lines.en: : I don't know. Ask Geoffrey.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。你去问 Geoffrey。

lines.en: : Anyway, after the first slice, I realized I’m not even that hungry. So if you want any, just let me-
lines.zh: : 总之，吃完第一片之后，我发现我其实没那么饿。所以如果你想吃，就告诉我——

lines.en: : I don’t want any pizza, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 我不吃披萨，Ayane。

lines.en: : Okay. I'm just going to go back to stabbing it then.
lines.zh: : 好吧。那我就继续戳它了。

lines.en: : Sure. You do that.
lines.zh: : 行。你继续。

lines.en: scene daysixthree1
So...this is basically my life now.
lines.zh: 所以……这基本上就是我现在的生活了。

lines.en: School is boring. So boring that I often think I wouldn't even bother showing up if there weren't so many skirts all over the place.
lines.zh: 学校很无聊。无聊到我经常觉得，如果不是到处都是裙子，我根本懒得来。

lines.en: In fact, I can pretty confidently say at this point that is the only reason I would understand someone keeping this job.
lines.zh: 事实上，我现在可以相当自信地说，这是我能理解一个人继续干这份工作的唯一理由。

lines.en: Maybe there is some real joy in teaching that I just don't understand (Likely on account of not having tried that yet)...
lines.zh: 也许教书这件事里确有某种我体会不到的真正的快乐（很可能是因为我还没试过）……

lines.en: But overall, I'm going to give this job a 6/10. I'm much more suited for something like...what Makoto does.
lines.zh: 但总的来说，我给这份工作打个 6 分（满分 10 分）。我更适合干……像 Makoto 干的那种活。

lines.en: Which is funny since she's much more suited for what I do.
lines.zh: 有趣的是，她反而更适合干我这个。

lines.en: I wonder if she'd be okay with switching every now and then?
lines.zh: 不知道她愿不愿意偶尔跟我换换？

lines.en: scene daysixthree3
The sound of the classroom door sliding open pulls me away from a relatively unethical inner monologue.
lines.zh: 教室门被拉开的声音，把我从一段相当不道德的内心独白中拽了出来。

lines.en: : Hey! Long time, no see! You feeling okay now?
lines.zh: : 嘿！好久不见！你现在感觉好点了吗？

lines.en: : Hey! Morning, Chika.
lines.zh: : 嘿！早上好，Chika。

lines.en: : And yeah! I'm totally fine. No worries here! Are you doing, uhh...you know...the word?
lines.zh: : 嗯！我完全没事。别担心！你今天过得，呃……你知道的，那个词？

lines.en: : Good?
: Yeah! Well...technically I think it's well. But I'm just gonna assume you're both of those things so I don't sound any more awkward than I am sure I sound right now!
lines.zh: : 对！嗯……严格来说我觉得应该是「很好」。不过我就当你两个都是了，免得我听起来比现在更别扭！

lines.en: Good...
lines.zh: 很好……

lines.en: It looks like Rin’s slump is over and she's finally ready to start coming to class again...
lines.zh: 看来 Rin 的低谷过去了，她终于准备好回来上课了……

lines.en: scene daysixthree4
: Hey! Sorry I’m late! There was some little girl outside the[school] who lost her cat, so I was helping her look for it and whatnot.
lines.zh: : 嘿！抱歉我迟到了！[school]外面有个小女孩把猫弄丢了，我在帮她找猫什么的。

lines.en: : Rin...do you really think I care about you being late?
lines.zh: : Rin……你真的以为我会在乎你迟到吗？

lines.en: scene daysixthree5
: Nope! But as a born-again student, I am obligated to inform you of my tardiness whenever possible.
lines.zh: : 不会！但作为一个重生的好学生，我有义务尽可能地向你汇报我的迟到。

lines.en: : Please have mercy on my unfortunate soul and do not give me detention.
lines.zh: : 请可怜可怜我这不幸的灵魂，别让我留堂。

lines.en: : Welcome back, Rin.
lines.zh: : 欢迎回来，Rin。

lines.en: scene daysixthree5r
: Thanks, Sensei. Believe it or not, you were a big help.
lines.zh: : 谢谢老师。信不信由你，你帮了大忙。

lines.en: : Well, I’m glad you’re feeling better.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我很高兴你感觉好些了。

lines.en: : Same.
lines.zh: : 我也是。

lines.en: : Let's just hope it lasts this time.
lines.zh: : 只希望这次能持续得久一点。

lines.en: scene daysixthree6
Rin skips her way over to her desk and Futaba immediately turns her chair around to talk to her.
lines.zh: Rin 一路蹦跳着走到自己的座位前，Futaba 立刻把椅子转过来跟她说话。

lines.en: I’m sure Futaba knew that she’d be coming back soon, but it’s still cute seeing how excited she gets knowing that her friend is feeling better.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定 Futaba 早就知道她快要回来了，但看到她因为朋友好起来了这么兴奋，还是挺可爱的。

lines.en: Or, at the very least, acting better.
lines.zh: 或者至少，是「表现得好起来了」。

lines.en: It's impossible to know for sure, isn't it?
lines.zh: 毕竟谁也没法真正确定，不是吗？

lines.en: : Mornin', roomie! How lonely were you without me on a scale of one to seven?
lines.zh: : 早上好，室友！我不在的这些天，你有多孤单？一到七分是几分？

lines.en: : Maybe...a six?
lines.zh: : 大概……六分？

lines.en: : A six? Not a seven? Who are you and what have you done with my Futaba?
lines.zh: : 六分？不是七分？你是谁，你把我家的 Futaba 怎么了？

lines.en: : Wait...don't tell me Sensei corrupted you while I was away, did he?!
lines.zh: : 等等……别告诉我，是老师趁我不在的时候把你教坏了？！

lines.en: : Do you even need me anymore?!
lines.zh: : 你不再需要我了吗？！

lines.en: : What is my life coming to?!
lines.zh: : 我的人生到底变成什么了？！

lines.en: : Heheh...Okay, fine. A seven.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……好吧，好吧。七分。

lines.en: : How are you feeling today?
lines.zh: : 你今天感觉怎么样？

lines.en: : Like a box of chocolates! Or...however the saying goes.
lines.zh: : 就像一盒巧克力！或者……不管那句话是怎么说的。

lines.en: : It...doesn't go anything like that at all.
lines.zh: : 那句话……根本不是这么说的。

lines.en: : Well, whatever. I’m feeling pretty good!
lines.zh: : 嗯，管它呢。我现在感觉挺好的！

lines.en: : Oh, also- I talked to Haruka this morning and she said she's gonna start giving me overtime to make up for some of the cash I missed out on during my sad-Rin phase.
lines.zh: : 哦，还有——我今早跟 Haruka 说了，她说要开始给我排加班，补回我在「丧 Rin 期」错过的一些收入。

lines.en: : Soooo...if you still want to go to that convention next month, I’m totally down.
lines.zh: : 所以呢……如果你还想去下个月那个展会，我完全没问题。

lines.en: Convention?
lines.zh: 展会？

lines.en: If Futaba is the one who's excited to go, I’m sure it's some sort of...sci-fi convention or something.
lines.zh: 如果是 Futaba 想去，我敢说那大概是某种……科幻展之类的。

lines.en: With conventions comes cosplay...
lines.zh: 有展会就有 cosplay……

lines.en: And with cosplay comes the opportunity to see the two of them in potentially revealing outfits that I may never have an opportunity to see again.
lines.zh: 而有 cosplay，就有机会看到她们两个穿上可能相当暴露的衣服——那种机会我大概再也遇不上第二次。

lines.en: This is a conversation I must now be a part of.
lines.zh: 这段对话，我现在必须参与。

lines.en: scene daysixthree7
: Woah! Back already? I get that you missed me, but could you at least let me catch up with Futaba first?
lines.zh: : 哇！这么快就回来了？我知道你想我了，但至少让我先跟 Futaba 叙叙旧吧？

lines.en: : Good morning, Sensei. How are you today?
lines.zh: : 早上好，老师。你今天怎么样？

lines.en: : I’m fine. I just came over to hear about whatever convention thing you two are talking about.
lines.zh: : 我还好。我只是过来听听你们说的那个展会是怎么回事。

lines.en: scene daysixthree8
: And now you're eavesdropping on our conversations?! What if we were talking about boys?! Then what, Sensei?! Then what?!
lines.zh: : 你现在还偷听我们说话了？！万一我们在聊男生怎么办？！那你怎么着，老师？！你怎么着？！

lines.en: : Then you should have been talking quieter. I could hear you two from the other side of the room. That basically makes me a part of the conversation as well.
lines.zh: : 那你们就该小声点。我在教室另一头都能听见你俩。这基本上就等于我也算是这段对话的一员了。

lines.en: scene daysixthree9
: Psst, Futaba...
lines.zh: : 喂喂，Futaba……

lines.en: : You...know he can still hear you, right?...
lines.zh: : 你……知道他还能听见吧？……

lines.en: : Should we tell him about the thing? I wanna tell him about the thing.
lines.zh: : 我们要不要告诉他那件事？我想告诉他那件事。

lines.en: : Umm...I don’t see the harm in it...I just...don't know if he'd be interested...
lines.zh: : 嗯……我觉得说了也没什么……只是……不知道他会不会感兴趣……

lines.en: scene daysixthree9r
: Sensei, it has come to my attention that I am now able to inform you that Futaba and I will be attending a book convention. Please hold your applause.
lines.zh: : 老师，我现在获准通知你：我和 Futaba 要去参加一个书展。请忍住你的掌声。

lines.en: : Why...would I applaud that?
lines.zh: : 我……为什么要为那个鼓掌？

lines.en: That's a little unfortunate...and significantly more boring than I was hoping for.
lines.zh: 这有点遗憾……也比我期待的无聊得多。

lines.en: I don't have anything against books. And I'm sure there will be some costumes there...but I doubt it will be on the level of a sci-fi or anime convention.
lines.zh: 我对书没什么意见。而且我敢肯定现场也会有一些 cosplayer……不过我怀疑达不到科幻展或动漫展的级别。

lines.en: : Hey, man. Sometimes, people just want to clap. Figured you might be one of those people.
lines.zh: : 嘿，老兄。有时候，人就是想鼓个掌。我猜你可能是那种人。

lines.en: : I...normally have to drag Rin along to these conventions with me since...I buy too much and have trouble carrying everything.
lines.zh: : 我……平时都是硬拉着 Rin 陪我去这些展会的，因为……我买太多，拿不动。

lines.en: : I'm not surprised, knowing you. What other stuff is there to do at a book convention, though? With all due respect, that sort of thing doesn't sound very...exciting.
lines.zh: : 认识你，我一点也不意外。不过书展上还有别的可玩吗？恕我直言，那种活动听起来不太……刺激。

lines.en: scene daysixthree9r2
: You haven’t been to one, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 老师你没去过吗？

lines.en: : Not to my knowledge.
lines.zh: : 据我所知没有。

lines.en: if futabadorm15 == True:
scene daysixthree10
: That’s a little surprising...
lines.zh: : 这有点意外……

lines.en: : I figured that...with being such a good writer and everything...you'd have gone to at least one.
lines.zh: : 我还以为……你文笔那么好什么的……至少会去过一次。

lines.en: scene daysixthree11
: ...Is there a problem, Rin?
lines.zh: : ……有问题吗，Rin？

lines.en: : Problem? No. Just...have you guys been getting to know each other better lately?
lines.zh: : 问题？没有。只是……你们两个最近是不是走得更近了？

lines.en: : We have. I’ve been helping Futaba with her self-confidence.
lines.zh: : 是的。我一直在帮 Futaba 建立自信。

lines.en: scene daysixthree12
: What he's actually been doing is helping me with my writing...but I guess the...self-confidence is a side effect of that...
lines.zh: : 他其实一直在帮我改稿……不过我想……自信算是那件事的副作用吧……

lines.en: : It's really just a lot of...story critique in the library and whatnot...
lines.zh: : 基本就是在图书馆里做很多……故事点评之类的……

lines.en: scene daysixthree13
: Oh. Cool. Yeah. That's...really cool.
lines.zh: : 哦。挺好。嗯。那……真的挺好的。

lines.en: else:
scene daysixthree7
: Dude, you should totally go to one! They’re a lot more fun than they sound, I promise!
lines.zh: : 老兄，你真该去一次！它们比你想象的有意思多了，我保证！

lines.en: : Umm...I...actually think they sound really fun, so...
lines.zh: : 嗯……我……其实觉得它们听起来很有意思，所以……

lines.en: : So where is this thing? It’s in Kumon-mi, right?
lines.zh: : 那这个展会在哪儿？在 Kumon-mi 对吧？

lines.en: scene daysixthree14
: I mean...it’s not like we can really go anywhere else.
lines.zh: : 我是说……我们也没别的地方可去啊。

lines.en: : They change the venue every year, but I'm pretty sure it's being held somewhere in the urban district this year.
lines.zh: : 举办地点每年都换，不过我挺确定今年是在市区那边。

lines.en: : I haven't checked in a little while since I was starting to think I wouldn’t make it this year.
lines.zh: : 我有一阵子没去查了，因为我开始觉得今年大概去不成了。

lines.en: : Cause of me, obviously. She's talking about me.
lines.zh: : 因为我，显然。她说的是我。

lines.en: scene daysixthree15
: I-I didn’t mean it like that! I'm sorry! I-
lines.zh: : 我……我不是那个意思！对不起！我——

lines.en: : Dude, it’s fine. I’m just kidding around.
lines.zh: : 老兄，没事。我逗你玩的。

lines.en: : If I can’t laugh at the shitty parts of myself, there's pretty much no point in living at all. So just humor me when I say stuff like that.
lines.zh: : 如果我连自己身上那些烂摊子都笑不出来，那活着也没什么意思了。所以我说这种话的时候，你就顺着我就行。

lines.en: : Truth be told, if it weren’t for you and Sensei, I’d probs still be staring off into space in the dorm.
lines.zh: : 说实话，要不是有你和老师在，我大概还在宿舍里对着空气发呆呢。

lines.en: : So...thanks for being there for me and stuff.
lines.zh: : 所以……谢谢你们陪着我什么的。

lines.en: scene daysixthree16
: Umm...I’m sure I can speak for both of us when I say this, but-
lines.zh: : 嗯……我想我可以代表我们两个说这句话，不过——

lines.en: : We’re glad to have been there for you.
lines.zh: : 我们很高兴当时能陪着你。

lines.en: : Sensei was really worried, you know? I don’t think I’ve ever seen him look like that before.
lines.zh: : 老师真的很担心你，你知道吗？我从没见过他露出那种表情。

lines.en: scene daysixthree17
: ...What? Don't look at me like that.
lines.zh: : ……什么？别那样看着我。

lines.en: : Were you really that worried about me, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 老师，你真的那么担心我吗？

lines.en: : Do you think I would have visited you if I wasn’t?
lines.zh: : 如果我不担心，你觉得我会去看你吗？

lines.en: : I might be the world’s worst teacher, but even I get a bit mystified when one of my students suddenly disappears for an extended period of time.
lines.zh: : 我也许是全世界最烂的老师，但就连我，在有个学生突然消失那么久的时候，也会有点摸不着头脑。

lines.en: : Tell the truth. You probably just missed my top-tier customer service and delicious custom beverages, right?
lines.zh: : 说实话。你大概只是怀念我顶级的顾客服务和好喝的特调饮品吧？

lines.en: : Oh yeah...Rin told me you volunteered to be her, umm...what did she call it?
lines.zh: : 哦对……Rin 跟我说过，你自告奋勇当她的，嗯……她怎么说的来着？

lines.en: : Guinea pig?...
lines.zh: : 小白鼠？……

lines.en: : That’s correct. So if I suddenly die, please inform the police that she is a prime suspect.
lines.zh: : 没错。所以如果哪天我突然死了，请通知警方，她是头号嫌疑人。

lines.en: : Oh please. As if I'd leave any evidence that could be traced back to me. Who do you take me for, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 拜托。我怎么可能留下能追查到我身上的证据。老师，你把我当什么人了？

lines.en: : A...psychopath?
lines.zh: : 一个……精神变态？

lines.en: : A psychopath who gets the job done...
lines.zh: : 一个能把活儿干完的精神变态……

lines.en: : You really worry me sometimes, you know.
lines.zh: : 你有时候真让我担心，你知道吗。

lines.en: : Obviously. Isn't that how this whole thing started?
lines.zh: : 显然。这不就是整件事的开头吗？

lines.en: : So, Futaba...will there be any cosplayers at this book convention thing?
lines.zh: : 那么，Futaba……这个书展上会有 cosplayer 吗？

lines.en: scene daysixthree17r
: Is...cosplay something you're actually interested in, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 老师……你是真的对 cosplay 感兴趣吗？

lines.en: : I think I can safely speak for all men when I say absolutely.
lines.zh: : 我想我可以代表全体男性安全地回答：绝对感兴趣。

lines.en: : Dear diary...Today, I learned about one of my teacher's fetishes.
lines.zh: : 亲爱的日记……今天，我发现了我的老师的一个癖好。

lines.en: : I am not ashamed to admit this.
lines.zh: : 承认这一点，我一点也不觉得丢人。

lines.en: : Let me guess...you only came over here to find out if we’d be cosplaying...You don't care about those poor, little books at all.
lines.zh: : 让我猜猜……你过来只是为了打听我们 cos 不 cosplay……你根本一点也不在乎那些可怜的小书本。

lines.en: : What an absurd accusation.
lines.zh: : 这指控也太荒谬了。

lines.en: : Your face...says otherwise, though...
lines.zh: : 不过你的表情……说的可是另一回事……

lines.en: : Futaba, don't go along with her. You're supposed to be the nice one.
lines.zh: : Futaba，别跟着她起哄。你应该是那个好孩子才对。

lines.en: scene daysixthree18
: Wait a second! Does that imply that I'm the mean one?!
lines.zh: : 等一下！那意思是说我是那个坏孩子吗？！

lines.en: : Do you actually hate me now?! I thought we had a thing, Sensei! I thought we had a thing!
lines.zh: : 你现在是真的讨厌我了吗？！我还以为我们之间有点什么，老师！我还以为我们之间有点什么！

lines.en: : I don’t think Sensei hates you, Rin...
lines.zh: : 我觉得老师不讨厌你啦，Rin……

lines.en: : You're just...not as nice as me. Which is fine. Because we all love you anyway.
lines.zh: : 你只是……没我那么乖。不过没关系。因为我们照样喜欢你。

lines.en: scene daysixthree19
: And now I'm being consoled?! Just what kind of alliance did you two form while I was away?!
lines.zh: : 现在我又被安慰了？！我不在的这段时间，你们两个到底结成了什么同盟？！

lines.en: scene black
I wind up chatting with Rin and Futaba until the bell rings for lunch.
lines.zh: 我最后跟 Rin 和 Futaba 一直聊到午饭铃响。

lines.en: As it turns out, there are going to be some cosplayers at the book convention they're going to, but neither of them plan on joining in this time.
lines.zh: 结果证明，她们要去的那场书展上确实会有一些 cosplayer，但她们两个这次都不打算参加。

lines.en: Shame. I feel like even I would have shown up if things were a little different.
lines.zh: 可惜。我觉得要是情况稍微不同，连我都会去的。

lines.en: But I digress...
lines.zh: 不过扯远了……

lines.en: At the end of the day, I’m glad that Rin seems to be back to her ‘usual’ self...whatever that means.
lines.zh: 到头来，我很高兴 Rin 似乎回到了她「平常」的样子……不管那意味着什么。

lines.en: I just hope I don't have to see her break down again any time soon...
lines.zh: 只希望短时间内不用再看她崩溃一次……

lines.en: For both her sake and Futaba's sake.
lines.zh: 为了她，也为了 Futaba。
